title: Parents separate and move to Atlanta
summary: The family leaves Fitzgerald when his father takes a niece away; Green and his mother go to his grandmother in Atlanta and his music lessons lapse.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, as I say, I cannot say years because only two years came, and then we had to leave Fitzgerald, Georgia. My parents didn't actually separate or divorce or anything, but they separated because my father had one of his brother's daughters there that he had been taking

care of because her parents got killed, murdered, you know, covered wagon some time ago. And she was left in his care. So he was -- he had to take her. Her name was Annie B. -- Annie B., you see, take her to Leslie, Georgia, I think it is. And my mother and I, he sent us to -- my mother -- my mother's mother's city where she was in, Atlanta, Georgia. So we went our ways, you know.
And that's when most of my music lessons discontinued, see. At that time I was being taught like -- I had a little violin I used to play a little bit.
